text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (T'morrow is Valentine's Day, and I'm gonna make it a special one! How?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna treat Trainer to some chocolatey goodness!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's always help'n me out. It's 'bout time I show my 'ppreciation back!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I'm gonna do my best t'make a chocolate lava cake! Everyone's show'n their support, so I can't fail!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's the long and short of it. So d'you think y'could teach me a good recipe, Flash?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I asked Hishiama first, but she told me t'ask you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. And it's a chocolate lava cake you wish to make, yes?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's right. D'you think it'll be too tough? I'd like t'give it a go, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I hardly know my left hand from my right in the kitchen. My mom always had t'help me, even if I was just melt'n chocolate…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But since this is for Trainer, I really wanna make someth'n spiffy… and scrumptious to boot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I really, really wanna do this right, so please help me! Pleeeease!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. You needn't get so worked up. Chocolate lava cake isn't that difficult to make.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: On the contrary, it's a good dessert for beginners. Even simplified recipes can produce delicious results rich in both form and flavor.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'don't say! Then that means…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall give you an easy recipe that will allow you to communicate your feelings to your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Looks like Fuji was right! Flash really came through. I bet you'll be able to handle that recipe just fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're prob'ly right, but I'm still worried I'll muck things up. Do you think you could help me with my first attempt?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you just want help this time? I can lend you a hand on the day of too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine! I wanna make it on my own when it's time for the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If that's what you want… Let's get started, then. Can you crack some eggs for me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No sweat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tap, tap… CRUSH!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The egg imploded!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, this li'l snowman toothpick's so cute! Maybe I can use it as decoration.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'll look real cute! And don't stop there. Wouldn't it be cute if you dust the plate with powdered sugar too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, that'll make it look just like a winter wonderland! This decoration's pretty nifty-look'n too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just handing the plate to your trainer lacks oomph, though. You should give it a more personal touch and set up a little cafe, Yukino style!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jinkies, that's a great idea! I'm so glad I mustered up the courage t'ask you for advice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ I can't help cheering for hard workers like yourself!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now, to top things off… I'll teach you the perfect little spell for when you serve it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A spell?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh! So here's what you should say…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-that spell… I hope I can pull it off…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, I can worry about that later. First off, I gotta make a delicious chocolate lava cake!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All righty! Time t'swing for the fences!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day, and Yukino Bijin has asked me to meet her at the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C'mon in! Welcome to Cafe Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And suddenly, I've been thrust into some kind of interactive theater. I'm not quite sure what Yukino Bijin's trying to do, but I decide to play along.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We only have one item on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It also happens t'be our number one recommended item. Would you like t'give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! I'll be right back with your order!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin comes back shortly and sets down a chocolate lava cake with the most adorable plating and decorations.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This is our Snow Chocolate Lava Cake. Our chef made it with love.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Before you start eat'n, there's a li'l spell I need to cast…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'know what, never mind! Go ahead and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I cut into the moist cake and warm chocolate sauce spills out. Sweetness overwhelms my senses when I take my first bite.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: S-so… what do y'think?
choice_data_list: I'd like to speak with the chef, please.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I must thank them for such a delicious cake!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Really? You like it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, well… As a matter of fact, you're look'n at the chef right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No, it's my pleasure! Thank you, Trainer! For everyth'n you do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Before you start eat'n, there's a li'l spell I need to cast…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C-c'mon, Yukino! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My heart belongs to you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So I hope this cake tastes sweet and true! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wheeew! I-I did it, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and dig in while it's still nice and warm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I cut into the moist cake and warm chocolate sauce spills out. Sweetness overwhelms my senses when I take my first bite.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a relief!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad y'like it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A lotta folks helped me prepare for t'day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna thank them, so would it be okay if give 'em some cake too?
choice_data_list: Of course! And I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! In that case…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's get ready for the grand open'n of Cafe Yukino and Co.!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Yukino Bijin invites her friends, and we all enjoy a lively Valentine's Day together.
